value.title: Rendered contrast, zoom and keyboard journeys
value.boundary: One Chromium run and bounded selectors, widths and states. This does not certify accessibility, arbitrary CSS painting, actual browser-toolbar zoom, screen-reader use or comprehension. Reflow, clipping and hit tests are measured; purpose and visual quality require review. Native media/control text and visually hidden input proxies require visual review. Identical repeated host observations are grouped.

value.title: Plain-language review
value.scope: Opening twelve non-code prose blocks and forty main-content link labels on every generated HTML route. English lexical prompts only; the rest of each page remains outside this scan.
value.boundary: Automated prompts are review candidates, not claims that prose is bad, undefined or misunderstood. Preserve voice and technical precision. Zero prompts never establishes comprehension. A human review must remain tied to the current source hash.
Missing browser evidence and the explicitly required Temple/Claimipedia text-spacing regression checks are release gates. Other observed findings remain visible for triage.
